### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

title: Senior Product Manager - Managed Security Services
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform** to be part of making that happen.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership – Cloud Platform**

* Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).

* Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.

* Serve as product owner for one or more development teams, owning the definition, prioritization, and hygiene of the backlog from concept through delivery.

* Partner with UX to define administrator and operator workflows that are simple, scalable, and consistent across the Endpoint Security portfolio.

  

**Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration**

* Define the cloud-side requirements for the unified agent initiative, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into one agent and one cloud, including feature parity, data model alignment, and deprecation sequencing.

* Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.

* Work with Engineering, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure migrations are seamless for customers, partners, and security analysts.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the product point of contact for cloud platform capabilities across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success.

* Ensure endpoint cloud capabilities integrate with Arctic Wolf’s broader platform and managed security services, improving analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the customer experience.

* Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal users to gather first-hand requirements, validate solutions, and understand operational challenges at scale.

* Brief Endpoint Security product leadership on roadmap status, delivery plans, and risks, and provide technical input to Product Marketing as needed.

  

**Metrics & Quality**

* Define and track product success metrics for cloud platform capabilities, spanning deployment and adoption, migration progress, platform reliability and performance, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

  

**Key Qualifications**

**Experience & Expertise**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years as a product manager at an endpoint security vendor (EPP, EDR, or XDR).

* Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, ideally including the cloud management console or backend services that administer endpoint agents.

* Experience working in high-growth organizations with globally distributed product and engineering teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  

**Technical Acumen**

* Sufficient technical depth to make product decisions involving endpoint agents, agent-to-cloud communication, device enrollment and identity, policy distribution, telemetry pipelines, and operating-system considerations across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

* Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS architecture, including multi-tenant services, APIs, microservices, identity and access management, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Ability to understand customer IT environments, company products, and services at a system, data flow, and API level.

* Hands-on experience with agile development practices and serving as product owner for engineering teams.

  

**Product Skills & EQ**

* Strong decision-making and follow-through, including defining the problem, evaluating alternatives and trade-offs, and measuring results against success criteria.

* Highly detail oriented, with the ability to manage complex dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams.

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to engineers, leadership, and customers.

* High EQ and a collaborative approach to partnering across functional teams and time zones.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading large-scale endpoint or cloud migrations, product consolidation, or re-platforming initiatives.

* Experience with device management, enrollment, or provisioning at scale (e.g., MDM/UEM or similar).

* Prior hands-on technical background, such as software engineering, solutions architecture, or sales engineering, before moving into product management.

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

title: Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose**

The Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is responsible for maximising the value of a specific Product by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead.
* Co-create the product vision and roadmap with the business and own the value case, including the expected benefits and how they are measured.
* Own and manage the Product backlog, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead (clear RACI boundary).
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Shape design trade-offs with Solution Architects, and scout emerging capability on the product platforms, bringing a short ranked opportunity list into backlog refinement.
* Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Product Manager and Domain Lead.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Own and prioritise the AI product backlog, translating Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI use cases, epics, features and acceptance criteria.
* Define the business value and success measures for AI use cases, including adoption, user experience, process improvement, quality, risk reduction and support effort.
* Lead AI-enabled product delivery across business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data specialists, security, quality and third-party providers.
* Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI, including appropriate human oversight, data protection, security, validation, traceability and regulated change controls.
* Monitor AI product performance after release, using operational metrics, user feedback and evaluation results to identify improvement priorities.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Typically 5+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Experience owning or delivering an AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics or intelligent automation product.
* Experience translating business problems into prioritised AI use cases, product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional delivery involving business SMEs, architects, engineers, data teams, security and compliance functions.
* Experience defining and monitoring AI product KPIs, evaluation criteria, adoption measures and benefits realisation.
* Experience delivering technology products in a regulated or highly controlled environment, with appropriate governance, validation and change control.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* AI product management: Ability to identify, assess and prioritise AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, data availability, risk and cost.
* Generative AI understanding: Good working knowledge of large language models, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and human-in-the-loop solutions.
* AI evaluation: Ability to define acceptance criteria and performance measures covering accuracy, relevance, consistency and user value.
* Responsible AI and risk management: Understanding of privacy, security, transparency, human oversight and risks such as unsupported or misleading outputs
* Stakeholder communication: Ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations and trade-offs clearly to business and technology stakeholders.

description:
**Job Title: Product Owner – ERM**

* The Product Owner turns business vision into customer value by acting as the voice of the customer and the primary point of contact for demand for the team. The role manages and prioritises a transparent product backlog, translates user and business needs into actionable items, and assures clear linkage through the golden thread from strategy to delivery. Working closely with business users, Product and Technology leads, Architects and the Agile Team, the Product Owner enables the realisation of agreed OKRs and delivers compliant, secure and scalable outcomes. The role also provides delivery assurance, supports product roadmap development and balances new change with operational resilience and institutional risk considerations.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define, communicate and cascade the product vision, value proposition, OKRs and roadmap across the end-to-end team so everyone remains aligned on what is to be built and why.
* Own the backlog end-to-end by managing intake and demand, expressing backlog items with acceptance criteria, prioritising demand and keeping the backlog visible, transparent and clear.
* Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, including decisions on what not to build where value is not evidenced.
* Build, refine and maintain a rolling wave product roadmap aligned to wider Value Stream and SVS goals, the Future State Architecture and re-use of existing assets where possible.
* Work with the Agile Team to evaluate solution options through prototyping, user research and early, continuous feedback on incremental releases.
* Make trade-off decisions based on value, risk and dependencies, including balancing short-term and long-term priorities, operational resilience and change.
* Accept or reject release-ready and released solutions against the Definition of Done and agreed acceptance criteria, and sign off product releases on behalf of users where required.
* Align and actively manage stakeholders across Business and Technology, resolve conflicting priorities and maintain clear communication with users and key stakeholders.
* Provide delivery assurance by inspecting outcomes, evaluating progress, supporting Agile ceremonies, PI and QPI events, and protecting team focus on prioritised work items.
* Ensure compliance, risk management and operational resilience are addressed within product scope, while supporting Agile, SAFe, CoE and Community of Practice best practices.

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong product management capability, with strategic thinking and a clear orientation towards value creation and delivery outcomes.
* Agile and SAFe acumen, including backlog ownership, prioritisation, delivery assurance and decision-making under uncertainty.
* Ability to identify and understand customer and business needs, and translate them into actionable backlog items, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation and conflict resolution across Business and Technology.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to align stakeholders to the product vision, roadmap and OKRs.
* Awareness of compliance, institutional risk, operational resilience and quality requirements within product scope.

**Desirable (nice to have):**

* Critical thinking, analytical problem-solving and data management literacy.
* Technology services awareness and the ability to work closely with Architects in keeping with the Future State Architecture and re-use of assets where possible.
* Experience of building and maintaining rolling wave product roadmaps and supporting PI or QPI planning events.
* Leadership without line management, including a coaching mindset and the ability to help enable high-performing, self-managed teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to participate in relevant Centres of Excellence and Communities of Practice.

**Additional Notes**

* This role owns backlog, prioritisation and value decisions within product scope, but does not carry direct line management responsibility, technical implementation decisions, budget ownership or enterprise-wide strategy setting.
* The Product Owner is expected to maintain a robust single intake management process, preserve the golden thread from strategy to delivery, meet the Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and make consistent use of the tooling spine.
* Good practice includes maintaining a transparent, well-groomed backlog, engaging stakeholders early and often, using data and feedback to inform decisions, prioritising based on value and risk, and ensuring compliance and security are built in rather than bolted on.
* Common pitfalls include acting as a mini project manager instead of a value owner, dictating technical solutions, allowing the backlog to become stale or unprioritised, overpromising or providing poor communication.

description:
**Job description**

**We're hiring**

**Product Manager E-commerce, CRO & AI Products**

Own the customer journey for CrazyNeon, a fast-growing custom signage brand serving customers across the US and beyond. This role blends e-commerce product thinking, conversion optimization, data, and applied AI — not a typical roadmap-and-tickets PM job.

Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.Gurgaon **On-siteProduct & Growth4–8 yearsFull-time**

**About CrazyNeon**

CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.

We're building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience — combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation, and AI.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences.

This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen.

A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage.

*The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person.*

**What you'll do**

**1. E-commerce product management**

* Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase.
* Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs.
* Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements.
* Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion.
* Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting.

**2. Conversion rate optimization**

CRO is a major part of this role.

* Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end.
* Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off.
* Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems.
* Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments.
* Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements.

Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience.

Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey.

**3. Data & analytics**

* Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities.
* Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance.
* Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working.
* Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations.
* Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment.

**4. Customer research**

* Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy.
* Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities.
* Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful.
* Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve.
* Turn customer problems into clear product requirements.

**5. AI & new-age products**

A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Potential areas include:

* AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation
* AI artwork analysis and preflight
* AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery
* AI-assisted quoting and configuration
* AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools
* AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows
* AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation
* Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

*You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.*

**6. Product strategy & roadmap**

* Maintain a prioritized roadmap based on revenue impact, customer value, effort, and strategic importance.
* Turn business problems into clear product requirements, briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Take products from idea MVP launch optimization, in step with engineering and design.
* Set KPIs for every major initiative.

**7. Experimentation & innovation**

We want someone who's constantly asking: *"What can we do differently?"*

* Track new e-commerce technologies and trends, and study companies doing e-commerce and AI well.
* Identify technologies that could give CrazyNeon a real edge.
* Prototype quickly, and test ideas before committing serious development resources.
* Help build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

**What we're looking for**

**Must-have**

* 4–8 years in e-commerce product management, growth product management, CRO, digital product management, or similar.
* Strong grasp of e-commerce customer journeys and conversion funnels.
* Hands-on experience running conversion rate optimization programs.
* Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with analytics platforms and user behavior tools.
* Ability to turn data and customer insight into product decisions.
* Experience working closely with developers and designers.
* Solid understanding of UX/UI principles.
* Strong communication and project management skills.
* A commercial mindset — you understand how product changes move revenue.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Shopify or similar e-commerce platform experience.
* Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, VWO, Optimizely, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.
* Experience with personalization or experimentation platforms.
* Experience building or shipping AI-powered products.
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI APIs, generative AI, computer vision, AI agents, or automation.
* Experience with custom products, configurators, or design tools.
* Experience in international (especially US) e-commerce.

**Who thrives in this role**

**Data-driven** — you look at the numbers before making product calls.

**Customer-obsessed** — you want to understand why customers behave the way they do.

**Commercially minded** — you know a product only succeeds when it creates measurable business value.

**Experimentation-oriented** — you'd rather test an idea than debate it for weeks.

**Technically curious** — you don't need to write production code, but you can work effectively with engineers and evaluate new technology.

**AI-curious** — you follow AI developments and can spot practical applications, not just hype.

**Entrepreneurial** — you're comfortable when requirements aren't fully defined, and you can build the solution rather than just execute someone else's roadmap.

**Hands-on** — you can move from customer problem hypothesis spec build launch analytics optimization, start to finish.

**How we'll measure success**

Website conversion rate

Revenue per visitor

Add-to-cart rate

Checkout conversion

Lead-to-order conversion

Average order value

Revenue from new product experiences

Adoption of new digital/AI products

Customer engagement

Number & quality of experiments run

Reduction in customer friction / manual work

**Why join CrazyNeon?**

This is a chance to build more than another e-commerce website. You'll help build the technology layer behind the next generation of custom signage commerce — AI-powered design, personalization, automation, configuration, and customer experience.

You'll have real ownership, and the chance to take ideas from concept prototype launch measurable business impact.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of data, e-commerce, product, technology, CRO, and AI — this role could be a strong fit.

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Proven experience in project management methodology
* Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
* Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
* Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
* Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
* Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
* Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
* Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

**About the Role**

The CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) Product Lead owns the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Mondelez International's CLM platform. Operating primarily within the DocuSign CLM ecosystem and connected procurement tools, this role bridges Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business stakeholders to drive adoption, optimize contract processes, and deliver measurable commercial value.

**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and communicate the CLM product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with enterprise goals and MDLZ procurement transformation objectives.

* Establish product KPIs and success metrics, and report progress to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the Contract Product roadmap and strategy, translating business needs into a prioritized delivery plan.
* Drive CLM deployment across Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and other business functions, ensuring consistent adoption and change management.
* Oversee ongoing platform support, including issue resolution, enhancement requests, and release management.
* Lead contract compliance management by ensuring contractual obligations are tracked and fulfilled, proactively identifying and preventing contract value leakage.
* Manage and develop a team focused on achieving zero contract value leakage across the enterprise through the Statement Review Process.
* Develop a Strategy for deploying Amazon Quick Agents for CLM.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business units to gather requirements, prioritize features, and manage expectations.
* Facilitate governance forums (Steering committees, Product Councils) to build consensus around roadmap trade-offs.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of the full contract lifecycle: authoring, negotiation, approval workflows, execution, obligation management, and renewal.
* Familiarity with procurement and sourcing processes as they relate to contract creation and management.
* Hands-on experience with CLM platforms and comfort with API/MCP integrations, data migration, and metadata modelling.
* Understanding of eSignature tools and requirements across geographies.
* Ability to engage credibly with IT architects and developers.
* Adjacent Procurement Tools: Experience with Coupa, Hicx, Sievo for spend analytics, and process orchestration platforms such as Pega or ServiceNow.

description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

 **Qualifications**

What you bring

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role

In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.

Why join us

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

You will own the product outcomes, priorities, and decisions that keep the program useful, safe, and deliverable.

* **Build the next-phase roadmap.** Use evidence from the pilot to prioritize production readiness, broader data coverage, a purpose-built analyst experience, and future client or regional expansion.
* You will report to the Senior Director of Product Management
* You will have to WFO 2 days a week as its Hybrid working

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Vacancy No**

VN1077

Senior Product Manager - AI

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.

About the Role
  
Purplle is hiring a Product Manager to own the post-order experience — everything a customer
  
goes through after placing an order: order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds, and customer
  
support. This is the part of the journey that decides whether a customer trusts us enough to come
  
back.
  
You'll own these flows end-to-end, treat them as products to be improved rather than systems to be
  
maintained, and be accountable for the metrics that show they're working — reachability of support,
  
resolution quality, and a smooth experience even when things go wrong.
  
What You'll Do
  

* Own the post-order journey end-to-end — order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds,

and order care — and set the roadmap, balancing quick wins (e.g., real-time tracking updates)
  
with longer-term bets (e.g., predictive self-service).
  

* Make customer support reachable and effective: improve discoverability of help across key

journeys, strengthen self-service and automation, and ensure clean escalation to a human
  
agent when needed.
  

* Reduce avoidable contacts (WISMO, status checks) by fixing root-cause friction in tracking and

communication — without making support harder to reach.
  

* Raise resolution quality, measured by repeat contacts, reopens, and post-resolution satisfaction

— not just the volume of cases closed.
  

* Monitor behavioural analytics regularly, spot abnormal changes, and turn insights into a

prioritised set of product fixes.
  

* Partner across Engineering, Design, Customer Support Operations, Logistics, and Finance to

ship improvements and align on SLAs, policies, and delivery realities.
  
What We're Looking For
  

* 3–4+ years in a product role, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech.
* Experience owning customer-facing journeys or post-order / order-management / customer-

support flows.
  

* Hands-on with data — comfortable with SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Looker,

Tableau) to frame hypotheses, run experiments, and measure impact.
  

* A systems thinker who maps complex end-to-end flows and finds the highest-leverage fixes.
* Customer-obsessed, with strong written communication and the ability to influence cross-

functional teams without authority.
  
  
Nice to Have
  

* Exposure to support tooling (Zendesk, Gladly, or similar), conversational automation / chatbots,

and returns or logistics platforms.
  

* Familiarity with India's e-commerce dynamics — COD, regional cohorts, and delivery realities.

About Purplle
  
Purplle is one of India's leading beauty e-commerce platforms, with 30M+ users and one of the most
  
diverse beauty catalogs in the country. We're building the operating system for beauty — connecting
  
consumers, brands, and beauty professionals in one ecosystem. This role owns the moment of truth:
  
what happens after the order, where customer trust is won or kept.

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's wireless and local area network product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering local area network or wireless capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering campus network improvements that increased coverage, user experience or reliability.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Product Owner qualification, such as SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager or Certified Scrum Product Owner.

* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.

* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.

**Job Description**

**About the Role**
  
At Purplle, we are building a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands that sell across general trade,
  
modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce. To scale them, we need a planning system that puts
  
the right product in the right channel at the right time, with the least working capital tied up. We are
  
looking for a Product Manager to build the core of that system: the products that power demand and
  
supply planning for our FMCG business.

  

**This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.**

* Youll work alongside the Senior Product Manager who leads our demand and supply planning

products, and own the execution and scale-up of our demand planning, S&OP and supply
  
planning products.
  

* Together, you'll replace spreadsheet-based planning with connected demand and supply

planning products that span our own plants and contract manufacturers.
  

* Your products will directly drive forecast accuracy, product availability across channels,

inventory efficiency and working capital, with a tangible impact on the company's bottom line
  
and on how fast our brands can grow.

**Key Responsibilities**
  

* **Roadmap & Execution**: Set a prioritised roadmap with the Senior Product Manager and own

delivery.
  

* **Demand Planning:** Build demand forecasting, sensing and planning at range, channel, product

and region level, including new product forecasting.
  

* **S&OP Collaboration:** Build the tool that runs the monthly S&OP cycle and aligns sales, planning

and finance on one plan.
  

* **Supply Planning:** Take FG Buying live and scale it into end-to-end supply planning.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Work with planners, operations, sales (GT, MT, e-commerce, quick

commerce), finance, data science and engineering to define requirements and drive adoption.
  

* **Discovery & Delivery:** Run discovery with planners, write PRDs and user stories, and manage the

backlog with agile teams.
  

* **KPI Ownership:** Own forecast accuracy and bias, fill rate for modern trade and quick commerce,

inventory health (days, excess, expiry) and adoption of the planning products.
  

* **AI-Native Building:** Identify where AI and LLMs can create outsized value in planning, such as

explaining forecast changes, surfacing demand anomalies and automating routine plan reviews.
  
Build these into the products, not as add-ons, and use AI tools to accelerate your own discovery,
  
specs and analysis.

**Desired Skills and Requirements**
  
  

* About 2 years of product management experience with clear ownership: you have taken

products from discovery through delivery and adoption, ideally in supply chain, operations or
  
internal tools.
  

* Hands-on exposure to demand and supply planning: forecasting and how accuracy is measured,

S&OP, and inventory norms (safety stock, reorder points).
  

* Exposure to Indian general trade, modern trade and quick commerce.
* Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of SQL; you make decisions backed by data.
* First-principles and systems thinking: you break ambiguous problems into structured pieces and

reason about how forecasting, S&OP and supply planning connect.
  

* High ownership and bias for action: you drive problems to resolution without waiting to be told.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and experience working cross-functionally in agile

teams.
  

* Engineering undergraduate degree. An MBA from a Tier 1 business school is good to have.

**Good-to-Have Skills**
  

* Python for analysis or prototyping.
* BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Metabase.
* Hands-on use of a planning tool such as o9, Kinaxis or SAP IBP.
* Exposure to ML-based forecasting or replenishment products.

**What You Will Gain**
  

* Zero-to-one ownership of demand and supply planning products for a fast-growing FMCG

portfolio.
  

* Monthly S&OP cycle exposure with sales, supply and finance leaders.
* A clear growth path, with your scope expanding as the products scale.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. The role translates QC, Quality, site, and regulatory needs into a prioritised LabWare LES backlog and leads delivery across the product lifecycle within strategic, financial, architectural, and GxP guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The Product Owner works closely with laboratory stakeholders, Quality, CSV, Tech, suppliers, and delivery teams to ensure LabWare LES capabilities are usable, validated, secure, supportable, inspection-ready, and aligned to standardised laboratory execution processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with QC laboratory, Quality, site, and digital stakeholders to understand laboratory execution needs and define LabWare LES outcomes that improve compliance, data integrity, analyst experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own and manage the LabWare LES product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, configuration needs, master data impacts, reporting requirements, validation expectations, and dependencies are clearly defined and prioritised.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on GxP impact, business value, laboratory criticality, data integrity risk, defect severity, release capacity, cost, and cross-site standardisation opportunities, escalating strategic trade-offs to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead.
* Lead delivery activities for LabWare LES changes, guiding Product Analysts, configuration specialists, testers, CSV resources, architects, engineers, and supplier teams to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, validated, secure, supportable, and aligned to architecture and quality standards.
* Ensure LabWare LES changes support controlled laboratory execution, including electronic worksheets, procedural step guidance, calculations, specifications, instrument or system interfaces, review-by-exception, audit trails, electronic signatures, and exception handling where applicable.
* Drive operational readiness by ensuring support model impacts, SOP updates, training materials, release communications, cutover plans, hypercare, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place before deployment.
* Maintain product performance measures for LabWare LES, including adoption, release throughput, defects, incident trends, validation progress, user experience signals, support effort, and benefits realisation; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes comply with GxP, CSV, data integrity, security, privacy, access control, change control, and supplier governance expectations, obtaining input and approvals from Quality, CSV, Security, Architecture, and other SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects and technical teams in assessing design options, integrations, environment management, reporting, performance, and dependencies with LIMS, instruments, ERP, document management, identity management, and other connected systems.
* Act as an escalation point for LabWare LES functional issues, defects, prioritisation conflicts, and release readiness decisions, balancing business continuity, compliance risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven delivery practices while maintaining the discipline required for validated systems, including traceability from requirements through design, build, testing, approval, release, and ongoing periodic review.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Typically 5+ years of experience in product delivery, laboratory informatics, LabWare LIMS / LES, QC laboratory systems, or process-led technology roles in a regulated environment.
* Proven experience defining, prioritising, and delivering requirements for laboratory execution, LIMS / LES, electronic worksheets, analytical workflows, reporting, interfaces, or validated laboratory systems.
* Experience working directly with QC laboratories, Quality, CSV, IT, suppliers, and site stakeholders to translate laboratory needs into feasible, compliant, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on GxP impact, data integrity risk, user impact, business continuity, technical complexity, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Experience supporting validated system delivery, including requirements, configuration, testing, defect triage, release readiness, change control, and deployment into controlled laboratory environments.
* Familiarity with regulated change management, periodic review, audit trail review expectations, user access governance, supplier management, and quality documentation for GxP systems.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches that simplify laboratory processes, reduce manual transcription, improve right-first-time execution, and increase adoption of standardised digital laboratory ways of working.
* Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery environments while maintaining appropriate validation, traceability, and release controls for regulated systems.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
